text:
emma: T-45 for the change window. We're still in the company-wide freeze (starts 00:00UTC). This is an exemption request thread for a small, safety-first hotfix that needs to go to canary only. I9m coordinating. @sylvia @liam
liam: Requesting exemption: tiny runtime memory leak fix in the kv-cache adapter. Patch is tiny, CI green, unit+integration all pass. We9d like canary in us-east-1 at 5% for 20m, no region expansion until explicit thumbs-up.
sylvia: Thanks. Please outline risk controls and rollback plan. Exemptions during freeze only allowed with clear SLOs, pinned rollback owner, and support note.
liam: Risk controls:
- canary -> us-east-1 only, 5% traffic, bake 20m
- automatic abort if error-rate + latency > thresholds
- manual rollback owner: @liam for first response, @emma for escalation
- no pin to dedicated or global expansion without 2x smoke pass
Commands I will use:
```
# start regional canary
deploy-bot rollout --id 5978000001-canary --region us-east-1 --percent 5 --image redwood/api:fix-kv-2026
# abort rollout
deploy-bot abort --id 5978000001-canary
# rollback to stable
deploy-bot rollback --service redwood-api --to stable-3.6.2
```
ops-bot: Alerting thresholds set for this exemption: p95 > 220ms OR error-rate > 0.9% => automatic page to oncall. Cost metric tracked (tokens/sec > 1.3x) will not auto-abort but triggers manual mitigation.
sylvia: Additional constraints: no release notes required for this internal fix, but support must be notified with a short context and rollback link. tia-support, can you prep a 1-liner for #support?
tia-support: Will do. Draft: "Applying a targeted canary (us-east-1) for a minor kv-cache runtime fix. No user-facing change expected; monitoring closely. Rollback link: deploy-bot rollback --service redwood-api --to stable-3.6.2"
emma: Good. One more thing: because we're in freeze, we need a two-person approval in thread before we kick. Sylvia, can you confirm?
sylvia: Approve for canary-only exemption. Conditions must be met: 1) deploy-bot preflight all green 2) canary smoke pass 2x separated by at least 6m 3) no pages during bake. If any condition fails -> abort and rollback. Approved.
deploy-bot: Preflight completed: image digest OK, migrations noop, config checksum matches. Canary plan ready.
liam: Kicking canary in 5. Running command now.
06:10:05Z deploy-bot: Canary 5978000001-canary launched in us-east-1 @5%. Bake timer: 20m.
06:14:30Z liam: smoke-1 results: 50/50 pass, 0 errors, embeddings parity 0.2% diff. Posting traces: s3://releases/exemptions/5978000001/smoke1.log
06:18:40Z ops-bot: Observability note: p95=170ms, error-rate=0.12%, cost=1.05x baseline. No page.
06:22:50Z liam: smoke-2 results (T+12m): 50/50 pass, 1 transient timeout re-tried, success. No regressions.
sylvia: Based on two good smokes and no pages, we can hold for remainder of bake. No expansion allowed.
06:30:05Z ops-bot: Bake midpoint. p95=190ms, error-rate 0.15%, cost trending 1.07x. All within thresholds.
06:34:55Z liam: final smoke at T+24m: 200/200 samples pass, no parity issues.
06:35:10Z deploy-bot: Canary bake complete. Status: healthy.
sylvia: Closing exemption: canary-only pass approved. Note: no pin to dedicated yet. Schedule follow-ups: 1) open a postmortem-only-if regressions PR in case we later see regression 2) liaise with CI to republish manifest for region digests tomorrow.
emma: Thanks everyone. Posting a short note to #release-notes per the freeze policy summarizing the exemption and canary result. Locking thread for archival. If anything pops, reply here. :lock:
